note: Working tree has uncommitted changes on top of this commit (see git_status_at_audit.txt). Inventory reflects the actual on-disk code, not the commit alone.
free_index_source: empty_idx=occ_class_names.index('free') passed as model constructor arg; hardcoded per-config, NOT derived from a schema. All audited configs set occ_class_names identically (occ3d 18-class list, 'free' last).
ignore_index_source: hardcoded literal 255 at every call site (get_voxel_loss, focal_loss.py, semkitti.py). Not a config field.
applied_heads: single primary occupancy_head, evaluated at 4 spatial scales (1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8) via num_stage=3 backward-projection cascade. No auxiliary/teacher head. Flow head (if enabled) is a separate L1 loss, out of scope for this inventory (not free-space related).
reduction_scope: local_batch (per-DDP-rank). No manual all_reduce in loss code; gradient averaging across ranks is the standard torch DistributedDataParallel behavior on backward(). Not independently verified in this audit (requires 2-GPU smoke, PENDING - no GPU designated).
camera_mask_semantics: mask_camera True = visible. invisible = ~mask_camera (stcocc.py:build_inv_free_voxel_weight line ~264-266). Verified by code reading + empirical sanity-check logs from prior training runs (visible-voxel fraction 12-24% per batch, consistent with raw npz mask_camera inspection done in this session: ~24% visible in 3 sampled raw GT files).

lambda_application.gate: voxel_weight is built (build_inv_free_voxel_weight) ONLY when camera_mask is not None AND self.lambda_inv_free != 1.0 (stcocc.py get_voxel_loss, ~line 300-305). At lambda=1.0 the weight-construction branch is skipped entirely -> identical code path to legacy w/o-mask (no weight object created or passed).
lambda_application.weight_formula: weight=1.0 everywhere; weight[invisible & is_free & valid]=lambda_inv_free; weight[~valid]=0.0 (defensive, unused downstream since every consumer already gates on ignore_index=255 independently).
lambda_application.scope: applied at all 4 scales when the corresponding voxel_mask_camera[_1_x] key is present in the batch (Stage2 configs collect these via Collect3D; Stage1 configs do not, so Stage1 baselines never touch this code path).

losses.actual_classification_kind: sigmoid focal loss (mmcv.ops.sigmoid_focal_loss on GPU), NOT plain softmax cross-entropy. use_sigmoid=True is asserted in __init__; the softmax-CE alternative (CE_ssc_loss in semkitti.py) exists in the codebase but is NEVER called from get_voxel_loss.
losses.logits_semantics: raw logits, shape permuted (B,X,Y,Z,C)->(B,C,X,Y,Z) before the loss call; internally treated as C independent one-vs-rest sigmoid channels (multi-label focal), not a single softmax distribution.
losses.supervised_grid: full X,Y,Z grid per scale (200x200x16 at 1/1; downsampled GT at 1/2,1/4,1/8).
losses.camera_mask_applied: NOT applied here directly as a hard ignore (that only happens upstream in the dataset pipeline for Stage1's baseline_with_mask policy, which bakes camera_mask into ignore_index=255 in voxel_semantics BEFORE this loss ever runs). For Stage2, camera_mask reaches this loss only via the continuous voxel_weight below.
losses.inv_free_weight_mechanism: voxel_weight (per-voxel, shape matches target) is reshaped and gathered at the same visible_mask indices as pred/target, multiplied into the existing per-voxel weight_mask (class_weight[c] * distance_term c[voxel]) is NOT how voxel_weight enters -- voxel_weight is a SEPARATE multiplicative factor applied only in the final reduction (_reduce_per_voxel_loss), not mixed into the per-class weight_mask.
losses.numerator: sum over included (non-ignored) voxels of (per_voxel_focal_loss_summed_over_classes * voxel_weight[voxel])
losses.denominator: sum of voxel_weight over included voxels, clamped to >=1e-6. When voxel_weight is None (lambda=1.0, or any Stage1 run, or any scale without a collected mask), denominator is instead a plain count (mean) -- i.e. TWO different reduction formulas exist in the code (_reduce_per_voxel_loss branches on `voxel_weight is None`), proven to coincide when voxel_weight would be all-ones (see gradient_coverage.csv, test lambda1_equivalence).
losses.class_weight: self.class_weights, an 18-vector loaded from config (occ-3d inverse-frequency-style weights), applied as weight[None,:] broadcast over voxels -- unrelated to inv_free weighting, present at every lambda value including lambda=1.
losses.extra_per_voxel_term: self.c: a fixed BEV-radial-distance term (bev_h=bev_w=200 grid, normalized [1,2]) baked into CustomFocalLoss at construction time via .cuda() -- this is why CustomFocalLoss cannot be instantiated on CPU-only; it is NOT related to camera visibility, it existed before this session's changes.
losses.coefficient: self.intermediate_pred_loss_weight[index] (per-scale loss weight, e.g. [1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125]), unchanged by this work.
losses.residual_inv_free_gradient: 0 by construction at lambda=0 -- voxel_weight=0 multiplies the per-voxel loss term in the numerator sum, giving exact zero gradient contribution from THIS loss for that voxel's logits. Verified in gradient_coverage.csv (test lambda0_zero_gradient) using the CPU-fallback py_sigmoid_focal_loss + _reduce_per_voxel_loss path (CustomFocalLoss module itself untested on CPU -- see PENDING items).

losses.actual_classification_kind: not a per-voxel elementwise loss -- a per-class precision/recall/specificity computed from GLOBALLY-POOLED weighted sums over the batch, then BCE-with-logits against a target of 1.0 for each of precision/recall/specificity. Softmax probabilities (F.softmax over the class axis) feed the pooled sums.
losses.logits_semantics: softmax over the 18-class axis (single distribution per voxel), NOT the same probability space as loss_voxel_ce (which is sigmoid/one-vs-rest). This is a pre-existing STCOcc design choice (two different logit interpretations consumed from the same raw logits tensor), not introduced by this work.
losses.supervised_grid: same grid as loss_voxel_ce at the same scale.
losses.target_mapping: raw class id, 255=ignore; class loop range is `range(begin, n_classes-1)` where begin=1 if n_classes==19 else 0 -- for our 18-class setup begin=0, and the loop EXCLUDES the last class index (n_classes-1 = 17 = free). Free-class probability is therefore never a direct optimization target of sem_scal_loss's per-class loop, though it still appears inside `p = pred[:, i]` denominators indirectly via softmax normalization.
losses.free_index: 17 (excluded from the per-class loop by range(...,n_classes-1); relevant only via softmax normalization, and via voxel_weight masking of ALL classes' sums at free-voxel positions).
losses.camera_mask_applied: same as loss_voxel_ce -- indirect only, via voxel_weight.
losses.inv_free_weight_mechanism: w = mask.float() if voxel_weight is None else voxel_weight * mask.float() (mask = ssc_target != ignore_index). This generalizes the ORIGINAL boolean subset-indexing (`p[mask]`, `target[mask]`) to a continuous multiply-by-w-then-sum-over-full-tensor pattern. Proven algebraically equivalent when voxel_weight is None or all-ones, since inserting exact floating-point zeros into a sum does not change the IEEE754 result (no reordering of nonzero terms) -- this is a bit-identical claim, not just approximate, and is checked in gradient_coverage.csv.
losses.numerator: per-class: nominator = sum(p * completion_target * w); precision/recall/specificity each computed as ratios of w-weighted sums (see code for exact 3 ratios).
losses.denominator: per-class: p_count = sum(p*w) for precision; pos_count = sum(completion_target*w) for recall; neg_count = sum((1-completion_target)*w) for specificity. Guarded with `if count > 0` (was `if torch.sum(...)>0` pre-change, semantically unchanged).
losses.class_weight: none (sem_scal_loss has no class_weights argument at all, unaffected by self.class_weights).
losses.residual_inv_free_gradient: 0 at lambda=0 for every one of the three (precision/recall/specificity) ratios' numerator AND denominator terms that involve an invisible-free voxel -- verified in gradient_coverage.csv (test lambda0_zero_gradient, sem_scal case). Note: this is 'zero DIRECT gradient from this loss', not 'zero total gradient into that logit' (other losses/scales may still supervise the same logit).

losses.actual_classification_kind: binary occupied-vs-free precision/recall/specificity (not per-class), same BCE-with-logits-against-1.0 pattern as sem_scal_loss, computed from softmax(pred)[:, empty_idx] as the 'empty' probability.
losses.logits_semantics: softmax over 18 classes, same tensor/softmax as sem_scal_loss (both read the same pred_voxel_semantic after permute).
losses.target_mapping: nonempty_target = (ssc_target != empty_idx) as float; empty_idx passed in as self.empty_idx=17 from the model, i.e. this function's 'empty' concept IS exactly the free class here (unlike sem_scal_loss's per-class loop, which excludes free).
losses.free_index: 17, used directly as empty_idx (not excluded -- this is the one loss where the free class is the explicit primary target of the binary split).
losses.camera_mask_applied: indirect only, via voxel_weight (same mechanism as the other two).
losses.inv_free_weight_mechanism: identical pattern to sem_scal_loss: w = mask.float() if voxel_weight is None else voxel_weight.to(...)*mask.float(); every sum (intersection, precision/recall/specificity denominators) multiplies by w and sums over the FULL tensor instead of boolean-subset-indexing. Same bit-identical-at-w=mask argument applies.
losses.denominator: precision: sum(nonempty_probs*w)+eps; recall: sum(nonempty_target*w)+eps; specificity: sum((1-nonempty_target)*empty_probs*w) / (sum((1-nonempty_target)*w)+eps)
losses.residual_inv_free_gradient: 0 at lambda=0 for the intersection term and both weighted denominators that include invisible-free voxels -- verified in gradient_coverage.csv (test lambda0_zero_gradient, geo_scal case).

losses.class_function: lovasz_softmax(probas, labels, classes='present', ignore=255) -> lovasz_softmax_flat -> lovasz_grad
losses.actual_classification_kind: Lovasz-Softmax: a rank-based Lovasz extension of the per-class Jaccard/IoU loss. Computed on torch.softmax(pred_voxel_semantic, dim=1) -- same softmax tensor as sem_scal/geo_scal.
losses.target_mapping: raw class id; `ignore=255` is passed straight to flatten_probas, which does a boolean `valid = labels != ignore` SELECT (not a continuous weight) before sorting.
losses.free_index: 17 (included in `classes='present'` iteration like any other class present in the batch; no special-casing).
losses.camera_mask_applied: ONLY via whatever ignore_index=255 was already baked into voxel_semantics upstream (i.e. Stage1's baseline_with_mask hard-ignore). Stage2's continuous voxel_weight is NEVER passed to this function -- confirmed: lambda_inv_free has zero effect on this loss's value or gradient at any lambda strictly between 0 and 1, and even at lambda=0 this loss still fully supervises invisible-free voxels.
losses.inv_free_weight_mechanism: NONE -- deliberate design decision (see stcocc.py comment at the lovasz_softmax call site). Rationale on record: Lovasz's gradient (lovasz_grad) is defined over a SORTED-by-error permutation of all included voxels via a cumulative-sum formula; injecting a continuous per-voxel weight would require redefining that cumulative-sum denominator (a nontrivial, unverified generalization the author chose not to risk, since Stage1 baselines share this same function unmodified).
losses.class_weight: none (class_weights param exists in the function signature but is never passed at the call site -- always None).
losses.reduction_scope: local_batch (per-image aggregation inside lovasz_softmax_flat since per_image=False is passed -- i.e. flattened across the WHOLE local batch, not per-sample-then-averaged; this differs from the other three losses' aggregation granularity and was not changed by this work).
losses.residual_inv_free_gradient: NONZERO at every lambda<1, INCLUDING lambda=0 -- this is the single most important known limitation, already flagged to the user and now formally logged: at lambda=0, invisible-free voxels are NOT fully removed from supervision because Lovasz continues to weight them at full strength. This means 'lambda=0' in the existing results is NOT equivalent to a full hard-drop of invisible-free supervision (matches spec section 1.3's own caveat about this exact point).

known_gaps_for_new_spec_requirements: No 'allterm_harddrop' diagnostic mode exists yet (spec 4.3/5.1 A4) -- would require excluding invisible-free from Lovasz's sorting population too, not implemented.

CustomFocalLoss cannot be instantiated without CUDA (self.c = ... .cuda() in __init__), so the FULL classification-loss module (including the BEV-radial distance term) has not been unit-tested on CPU in this audit -- only the shared _reduce_per_voxel_loss / py_sigmoid_focal_loss primitives were exercised directly with synthetic tensors, bypassing CustomFocalLoss's __init__.
DDP reduction_scope (item 7 in spec 4.2) not verified -- requires an actual 2-GPU run, PENDING (no GPU designated).
resume equivalence (item 8) not verified -- PENDING (no GPU designated, and no resume was ever exercised in the prior work).
